result.title: Seeing What Matters, Verifying What Pays: Load-Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language model (VLM) inference without altering the output distribution, yet two factors limit its gains. Existing drafters either lack the image evidence required for visually grounded tokens or pay to condition on every visual token, although a short draft block typically depends on only a few image regions. Moreover, the value of verifying additional candidates varies with GPU load, so no fixed verification structure is efficient across serving conditions. We present Uni-LaSpec, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework that addresses both factors. To improve draft quality, Uni-LaSpec reuses the verifier's own attention: the query retained from the preceding verification ranks the cached, int8-quantized visual keys, and a cross-layer vote selects a few visual tokens that the drafter fuses through gated cross-attention. Acceptance-aware training further weights each draft position by its contribution to the accepted prefix. To allocate verification, a marginal-cost criterion selects the structure per request and per round: draft trees exploit idle verifier capacity under light load, whereas a dynamic head truncates linear drafts under heavy load. Across six VLMs from three model families and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, selecting eight visual tokens retains at least 98.6% of the acceptance obtained from the full image at sub-millisecond selection cost. With greedy decoding at concurrency one, Uni-LaSpec achieves up to 5.11x text and 3.24x multimodal throughput over autoregressive decoding. Across six load levels and three GPU types, it outperforms autoregressive decoding in every setting and matches or exceeds the best fixed verification strategy in 123 of 144 settings; under bursty arrivals, it reduces mean end-to-end latency by 47.6% relative to linear verification.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Uni-LaSpec 块并行投机解码框架：复用验证器的注意力查询与跨层投票，从 int8 量化的视觉 key 中挑出少量视觉 token 供 drafter 通过门控交叉注意力融合，并按边际成本在线选择验证结构（轻载用 draft 树、重载截断线性 draft），在六个 VLM 上提速并降低时延。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按验证器注意力筛选少量视觉证据、以及按边际成本动态决定验证深度/截断的做法，与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选和「算多少、何时停」的计算分配问题可供核查对应；但论文目标是推理加速而非 latent 推理，联系需自行判断。
